name: lignazio/vibestatic
description: Static site generation for WordPress, with incremental deployment.

scripts-descriptions.prefix: Rewrites third-party dependencies into vendor-prefixed/ under WP2Static\Vendor\. Runs by itself after every install and update: there is no need to call it by hand.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Parses every PHP file with the current interpreter. It includes vendor-prefixed/, deliberately: it is the check that the namespace rewriting Strauss performed did not produce code that fails to compile.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: WordPress coding standards, in full. Still has 422 violations: documentation and style, which is why it is not in `test`.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs-security: The five security sniffs only — prepared SQL, nonces, escaping, sanitised input. This one is at zero, and has to stay there.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs-i18n: The internationalisation sniff only: string wrapped, right text domain, numbered placeholders where there is more than one, translator comment where needed. At zero, and has to stay there: a string left unwrapped does not show until somebody installs a translation.
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Regenerates languages/vibestatic.pot and the add-on's. Run it whenever a string changes; the .pot lives in the repository because it is the file translators open.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level max, with the accepted debt in the baseline.
scripts-descriptions.phpunit: Unit tests. Excludes the suite that makes real network requests.
scripts-descriptions.test: Everything that runs in CI and blocks, phpcs excluded: that is a step of its own so style debt cannot hide a security regression. When the remaining style violations reach zero, `@phpcs` comes back here and `@phpcs-security` becomes redundant.
scripts-descriptions.build: Builds the distributable zip into dist/, from the version declared in the plugin header.
